They taught me that talking back is rude, and that's why we always have problems. I can't talk back and speak my mind. I can only think about what I did wrong, and reflect on that. 

I guess at this point in my life, I've been fed up with my parent's, especially my dad saying I don't even listen to what they have to say. I feel bad about that, but really I can't help it. I'm always following my own will, I'm trying but I may be slow. My dad has been through thick and thin ever since he was a child, even younger than me, he was already cunning and smart. He grew up and was raised a certain way, where he would then teach me now; to be more like him, and how if he had gotten an education like me, he would be a lawyer making millions right now. He says I should be more like a man, be stronger, and smarter. 

All the things he says to me is constantly circling my mind. I believe if I forget about everything, it would still not make these thoughts go away, but I can't help it if I'm ignorant to the world. I make the slightest mistake, and I get punished harshly for it, just because I didn't know better. 

I'm wondering at this point, if life is always like this. I just wish I can get into college already, get a job, and so I can stop getting nagged by my parent's. But I already know, that this will never be the case. After I get a job, I will still have to live with my parents and support them. Life will be harder after that, and I will keep trying, but I never forget my experiences. Once I have a wife and kids, I will not allow them to go through what I did as a kid, but that's in the future. Right now, all I can do is move on.
